text:
Type: low woven rattan basket
Use: holding throws, magazines, toys or desk clutter on a shelf or the floor; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: rustic, farmhouse, coastal
Materials: hand-woven rattan with a grey washed finish, thick twisted rim
Colors: warm grey, greige, light driftwood
Shape: low wide rectangular tray with flared sides, chunky braided rim, cut-out handles on the short ends, open and sturdy, medium visual weight
Feel: rustic, relaxed, natural, cozy
Goes with: weathered wood, linen, white or grey walls, whitewashed furniture; farmhouse, coastal or rustic rooms

product.name: BYHOLMA
product.description: The basket is hand woven and therefore has a  unique look.
